item.title: The biggest CRT ever made: Sony's PVM-4300
item.description:
📝 Sony said at the time they hoped to sell 80 of them that year, but the recession may have kept that from happening. Sony could mass produce its smaller TVs. That’s just bad business.

item.title: A year of vibes
item.description:
📝 Social media exploded with opinions on AI: some good, some bad. I take issue with “agent” as a term because agency and responsibility should remain with humans. Similar with model selection.
